latestTerminalSummary:
EFFECTIVE_MODEL: opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, High effort, read-only critic (plan/read-only runtime — no writes performed), single-turn review report | requested = "OpenCode DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free", setting High (reviewer); configured = opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, High (self-report matches roster); confirmed = **unverified** — no provider-side session evidence of upstream served identity, effort, or family diversity; configured target is not proof of served identity.

VERDICT: pass

BLOCKERS: none. Every substantive, source-backed claim checked holds:
- README/CHANGELOG "published 0.1.1 = six line-oriented commands, no TUI extra" — verified against origin tag `v0.1.1` (6 `@app.command`, no `skill_lens/tui`, no `textual`/`[tui]` in `pyproject.toml`) and live metadata `h/coordinator/pypi-current.json` (`provides_extra:["dev"]` only).
- "Current branch = six commands + TUI entrypoint/controller/skeleton through U2" — `skill_lens/cli.py:233` adds the 7th (non-line-oriented) `tui` command; `tui/session.py`, `tui/app.py`, `core/snapshot*.py`, `presentation/*`, `core/cancellation.py` all exist and match the AGENTS map descriptions.
- Gate claims — `h/coordinator/pytest.log` (1021 passed, 1 case-insensitive skip, 91.16%), `mypy.log` (37 files), `ruff.log`, `format.log`; `pyproject.toml` has `branch=true`,`fail_under=90`, so "combined coverage (not branch-only)" is truthful.
- resource-risk.md numbers match the linked artifact `h/benchmark-results.json` exactly (payloads 16 778 912 / 67 110 560 / 16 777 429; largest 2/8/16 MiB; retained 16.04/32.07, 64.04/128.07, 16.02/32.03 MiB; peaks 22.05/88.05/64.04; overlap 38.08–38.09/152.09/80.05; wall ranges), `all_assertions_passed:true`, seed 20261016, source hash `af42…` matches the on-disk script.
- U1 historical figures (682/991 ms, 9.75/9.98 MiB) match `docs/validation/u1/BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md`.
- Scope/confinement — diff touches only AGENTS map+pointers, README status, DEVELOPMENT current-status, CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`+preamble, FULL_SCREEN_TUI header/handoff; plan change is **additions-only**; §20–22, Phase-2/5 archives, released CHANGELOG entries, and old `h/` evidence are unmodified. `preservation.json` + `scope-check.json` + git status confirm no product/test/CI/config/dependency change. All relative links in changed docs resolve (independent check); README links remain absolute per the PyPI rule. `stages A–G complete` is supported by per-stage acceptance records (A/B, C, D, E, F, G).

SUGGESTIONS (non-blocking; wording/consistency only, no measurement defect demonstrated):
- `docs/validation/assessment-repairs/h/benchmark_capture.py:12` — docstring says "no writes inside the repository", but `main()` always writes the artifact and the default path (`~L861-869`) is inside the repo (`h/benchmark-results-<stamp>.json`). Internal contradiction; reword to "no fixture/product-target writes; results artifact written under `h/` by default".
- `docs/validation/assessment-repairs/h/resource-risk.md:10` (and `benchmark_capture.py:9-10`) — "capture_session exercises the installed skill_lens runtime". The exercised module is the source checkout (`.venv` editable install, `direct_url.json editable:true`; script prepends `REPO_ROOT`; `preservation.json benchmark_imports_source_checkout:true`). "installed runtime" is defensible for an editable install but could imply an installed wheel; say "source checkout (editable install) with installed third-party deps" to avoid any Stage-H installed-wheel implication.
- `CHANGELOG.md:8-13` — the preamble drops the prior "plus a green CI run on macOS and Linux" claim that covered released entries (released sections themselves are untouched). If releases did have green CI, retaining/attributing that fact preserves the earlier claim; the current conservative wording is otherwise fine.
- `docs/validation/assessment-repairs/h/historical/STATUS.md:9,11` — dating uses different bases (pre-correction "2026-10-15" = UTC `22:58Z`; second-attempt "2026-10-16" = local `02:11`/UTC `23:11Z`) for the same local session. Label consistently or note UTC-vs-local as resource-risk.md does.

FILES_AT_RISK: docs/validation/assessment-repairs/h/benchmark_capture.py; docs/validation/assessment-repairs/h/resource-risk.md; CHANGELOG.md; docs/validation/assessment-repairs/h/historical/STATUS.md

CONCEDED (withdrawn points):
- Withdrew the README absolute link to `.../assessment-repairs/h/` as a broken-link finding: README and `h/` ship in the same change set, so on `origin/main` the link appears exactly when `h/` does — no live 404 window (`origin/main` currently has no `h/` tree, but also not the edited README).
- Withdrew "installed runtime" as a measurement defect: the venv is an editable install of the reviewed source, so the exercised code is the source under review; it remains at most a wording clarification, which is why it is a suggestion, not a blocker.
- Confirmed no scope breach and no historical-evidence rewrite: plan record is append-only; FULL_SCREEN_TUI §20–22, frozen §21/§22 contract, Phase-5 walkthrough body, released CHANGELOG sections, and prior `h/`/historical artifacts are preserved; out-of-scope worker log directory was not used to justify any claim.
